summary: Backend testing of CRM Follow-ups owner filter feature completed successfully. All 9 pytest tests passed (100%). Verified: GET /api/crm/follow-ups accepts owner_id parameter, __unassigned__ filter works correctly, owner_name is included in responses, GET /api/crm/team-members returns team members for dropdown. Manual curl tests confirmed full functionality with real data.

GET /api/crm/follow-ups.description: Returns unified follow-ups from leads and clients with owner_name resolved

GET /api/crm/team-members.description: Returns list of active team members for owner dropdown

critical_code_review_comments: Backend correctly resolves owner_name from user_id for all follow-ups
Permission check implemented for Sales role (forces filter to self)
The __unassigned__ filter correctly uses $or query for null or missing owner_id
Follow-ups sorted by date ascending (earliest first)
Status field correctly calculates 'overdue' vs 'pending' based on current date
seed_data_creation: Created 2 test leads with follow-up dates (1 assigned, 1 unassigned) - later cleaned up via discard endpoint
context_for_next_testing_agent: CRM Follow-ups owner filter feature complete. Backend endpoints: GET /api/crm/follow-ups (accepts ?owner_id param), GET /api/crm/team-members (for dropdown).
